job.question: In the Boston Retirement System's investment consulting services proposal questionnaire (Attachment 3), how many current public fund client references must be listed, and what minimum asset size must those clients have?
job.expected_facts: Up to 10 current public fund clients with assets greater than $1 billion for whom similar work was performed, giving name, contact, telephone number, asset values, number of years the client has retained the firm and the service used.
job.acceptance: Accept up to ten / no more than ten and >$1bn. Contact-detail fields and similar-work context are supplementary; exactly ten or at least $1bn is not equivalent.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System RFP, not the Boston Retirement System’s Attachment 3 questionnaire. Its reference requirement gives a different count and no asset threshold; its $1 billion criterion applies to minimum firm qualifications, not the requested client references.
quotes: City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System
Section 5 should include a minimum of three references from clients for whom similar services are performed
The firm must have at least two U.S. public pension fund clients, each with assets in excess of one billion U.S. dollars as of December 31, 2023.
Investment consulting firms must complete the Questionnaire titled Appendix A, which can be found as a separate document on our website at www.coaers.org/gic-rfp.
